name: 2.0.0-test-rc5 release checklist
description: Acceptance checks for the 2.0.0-test-rc5 release candidate.

items.name: Release identity
items.description: Dashboard, API, image, and OpenClaw versions match the release candidate.

fields.notes: Record version output and any mismatch.

items.name: Plugin navigation and sidebar
items.description: Compact labels remain readable and the sidebar never falls onto a white page background.

fields.notes: Test expanded and collapsed navigation on desktop and mobile-height viewports.

items.name: Public plugin host
items.description: Plugin index, diagnostics, navigation, and workspace pages agree on enabled public plugins.

fields.notes: Capture plugin index and diagnostics evidence.

items.name: Private plugin image
items.description: The private image loads only its intended plugin inventory from locked source commits.

fields.notes: Verify package access, plugin paths, source lock, and diagnostics.

items.name: Guardrails operations
items.description: Guardrails operations behave consistently and respect host capability grants.

fields.notes: Record each operation tested and any runtime limitation.

items.name: Evals operations
items.description: Evals operations and usage reporting behave consistently with the current plugin milestone.

fields.notes: Distinguish host-adapter behavior from future AI-judge execution.

items.name: Restart persistence
items.description: Checklist results, plugin discovery, workspace records, and OpenClaw state survive restart.

fields.notes: Check the same records before and after restart.

items.name: Automated regression suite
items.description: Local validation, coverage, and multi-architecture image CI are green.

fields.notes: Attach the local summary and CI run links.
